UNDERTAKINGS b.Tenant waives the right it has under the law to cancel this Lease and collect BY TENANT damages if Landlord does not deliver possession of the Apartment to Tenant on the date the term of this Lease is supposed to start.However, Tenant does not have to pay rent until the date it does get possession. c.Tenant will take good care of the Apartment. d.Tenant will make all repairs to the Apartment required because of something TenantorTenant'sGuestdidorfail todo. e.Tenant will comply with all laws,rules or regulations affecting the Apartment, including rules or regulations of insurance agencies. f.If a claim is made against Landlord because of something Tenant or Tenant's Guest did or fail to do,Tenant will pay toLandlord any money which a court rules that Landlord must pay, as well as any legal fees or costs which Landlord must pay because of the claim. g.Tenant will not,without Landlord’s written approval: 1.install any paneling, flooring,“built-in” decorations, partitions or railings or do any painting or wallpapering; 2.drill into or attach anything to the floors, walls or ceilings of the Apartment; 3.put in any locks or chain-guards or change any lock cylinders on the doors of theApartment unlesspermitted by law;landlord consents to tenant'slock. 4.bring into the Apartment any dishwashing，clotheswashing or drying machines or anyheating,ventilating，dehumidifying orwater-filled furniture; keep any animal in the Apartment; 6.do or permit anything to be done in the Apartment which will cause an increasein the cost of fireinsurance forLandlord; 7.permit the accumulation of refuse in theApartment. REMOVAL h.Tenant will remove all of its property at the end of this Lease and shall pay for AT END any damage to the Apartment orBuilding caused by moving its property in or out of OF TERM the Apartment.If Tenant leaves any ofits property in the Apartment,Landlord may dispose of it and charge Tenant for the costs of disposal or keep it as abandoned property. At the end of this Lease, Tenant will leave the Apartment in as good condition as it was when the Lease started,subject to reasonable wear and tear and fire damage. i.Tenant will comply with such reasonable rules as Landlord may adopt (on notice RULES OF to Tenant)for the safety,care and cleanliness of the Building and the comfort,quiet BUILDING and convenience of other tenants. j.Landlord shall not be liable for injury or damage tenant or Tenant's Guests or

NO their property unless it results from something Landlord or Landlord's agents, LIABILITY servantsoremployeesdidorfailedtodo. k.Landlord and its agents and employees may inspect the Apartment to any INSPECTION reasonable time,may have prospective purchasers of the Building and,during the BY last six (6) months of the Lease, prospective Tenants,view the Apartment LANDLORD between 9AM and 8PM.Landlord may authorize workmen to enter at reasonable times in order tomake repairs,improvements or decorations in the Apartment or Building;if Tenant is not there,Landlord may enter bya masterkey or if Tenant has changed the lock or done something else to prevent entry Landlord may enter by force. TENANT 1.Tenant shall take the Apartment in its present condition,except that Landlord TAKES shall do theworkindicatedinArticle5of thisLease. “AS IS"" m.Tenant shall not assign this Lease or enter into a sublease unless it is allowed by a law of the State of NewYork.If Tenant makes an assignment or sublease,with or without the consent of theLandlord,Landlord may collect rent from the new tenant and deduct it from any money Tenant owes under this Lease. If Landlord collects rentfrom thenew tenantit does not mean that Landlord consents to theassignment or sublease.Tenant shall remain liable under this Lease after a sublease or assignment,unless released by Landlord or unless otherwise provided by law. n.This Lease shall be subject and subordinate to the lien of all mortgages which SUB- now or in the future affect the Building.This means that the holder of a mortgage ORDINATION can,ifit so elects,end thisLease upon a sale of the Building in a foreclosure of the mortgage. o.Landlord shall have no furtherliability under this Lease on the dateit sells or RELEASE OF leases the Building,but shall remain liable for things whichhappened before that LANDLORD date. p.If Tenant does not comply with the terms of this Lease,Landlord may give a DEFAULT notice to Tenant demanding that Tenant must correct the default.If Tenant does not correct the default within 5 days after the date the notice ismailed(or within such longer period of time as may be reasonably required,if Tenant begins to correct the default in the 5-day period and thereafter continues to act diligently) then Landlord may give a second notice that this Lease shall end on the date setforth in the second notice.The date set forth in the second notice must be not less than5 days nor more than 10 days after the date the second notice ismailed.On the date setforthin the second notice this Lease shall end and Tenant shall deliver possession of the Apartment toLandlord,butTenant shall remain liable under thisLease. TENANT q.If this Lease has been ended as provided above,then Landlord may LIABLE re-enter and take possession of the Apartment by any lawful means,and remove FOR Tenant and Tenant‘s Guests and their property,by dispossess proceedings,or DAMAGES otherwise,without being liable in any way.Landlord may re-rent theApartment and any rent received by Landlord shall be used first to pay Landlord's expenses in getting possession and re-renting the Apartment,including,without beinglimited to, reasonable legal fees and costs, fees of brokers, advertising costs and the cost of cleaning,repairing and decorating the Apartment,and second to pay any amounts Tenant owes under this Lease.Landlord has no duty to re-rent the Apartment. Tenant shall pay to Landlord on the first day of each month any amounts Tenant owes under this Lease,less,if Landlord re-rents the Apartment,any amounts received from the new tenant and not used by Landlord to pay the expenses referred to above. 3.Landlord and Tenantagree asfollows: a.If there isa fire or other casualty in the Building and Landlord advises Tenant FIRE OR within 10 days thereafter thatit has decided not to repair the damage,thisLease OTHER shall end asofthedate of thefire andany rentpaid by Tenantfora period after DAMAGESthat date shall be refunded to Tenant.If Landlord does repair the damage,it shall be done as soon as practical and if the Apartment cannot be used, no rent shall be payable from the date of the damage until the date it can be used.Tenant hereby gives up the right to end theLease when theApartmentis unusable,except in a case where thereis less than 6months left in the term of thisLease.Each party hereby gives up any right of recovery against the other party for any loss in connection with any fire damage. b.If the Building or theApartment is taken by a governmental agency or other CONDEM- body having the right to take property,this Lease shallend on the date of the taking NATION and Tenant shall have no claim for the value of this Lease.Any rent paid by Tenant for aperiod after the date of the taking shall be refunded to Tenant. c.Tenant haspaid to Landlord NONE ($o.oo) as a security deposit. SECURITY DEPOSIT JURY TRIALd.Landlord and Tenant each waive trial by ajury in any matter which comes up

WAIVER,Nobetween them under thisLease or because of thisLease(except for a personal injury COUNTER-or property damage claim).In a proceeding to get possession of the Apartment, CLAIM Tenant shall nothave therightto makea counterclaim. e.Any notice by Landlord or Tenant to the other,or any consent by Landlord,must NOTICE beinwritingandmustbepersonallydeliveredtoTenantormailedbyregisteredor certified mail (return receipt requested)in a stamped envelope addressed (i)to Tenant atthebuilding and(i)toLandlord at165West73rd Street,NewYork,NY 10023or to such other address as Landlord shall specifyby notice toTenant. f.The provisions of this Lease shall run in favor of and be for the benefit of SUCCESSORLandlord and Tenant and anybody who succeedsto theirrespective interests in this Lease. 4.Landlord agrees that: QUIET If Tenant pays the rent and is not in default under this Lease,Tenant shall ENJOYMENTand may peaceably and quietlyhold,and enjoy theApartment forthe term of this Lease,subject to present and future mortgages as stated above. The rent reserved herein does not include air conditioning units or equipment. 9.Tenant shall not paint any exposed brick walls or wood trim doors and windows that is presently stained.The Tenant shall not make holes in the brick,only in the mortar,between the bricks,to hang shelves or pictures. 10.Tenant will be required,at his own expense,to payfor all electricity and gas used in the apartmentincludingbut not limited tolighting，heat,stove,oven,hotwater, air conditioning andelectrical appliances. 11.Landlord will not be responsible for plumbing waste line obstructions and/or stoppages,includingbut notlimited to toilets,bathtubs,sinks and dishwashers, whenTenantis atfault. 12.TheTenant specifically waives any rights or benefits,whichmay be derived from Section 226-boftheRealPropertyLaw.Tenant understands that thisLease prohibits the assignment of subletting ofthe tenancy，without the priorwritten consent of the Landlord whichthe Landlord maywithholdreasonablyor unreasonably.A declaration that this clause is invalid shall not affect the balance of thisLease. 13.It has been fully and clearly explained to the prospective Tenant that the premises is not subject to the Rent Stabilization Code of NewYork City,or to the provisions of the emergency Tenants protection act or to therent control laws of the city and state of New York. This building and the apartment that the Tenant is renting are not subject toany rent regulation laws whatsoever. 14.There will be a $25.00 fee on all bounced checks. 15.The Tenant understands that theLandlord does not maintain,nor is required to maintain insurance for the personal property of the Tenant.The Landlord recommends that the Tenant obtains,at the sole cost and expense of the Tenant,a "Renters Insurance Policy", that will insure the Tenants' personal property against any loss due to fire,theft,flood,leaks water damage and other similar perils. 16.Tenants,theirfamilies,guests,employees,orvisitors shall not make orpermit disturbing noises in the apartment or building or permits anything to be done that will interfere with the rights,comforts or convenience of other Tenants.Also, Tenants shall not play a musical instrument or operate or allow to be operated a phonograph,radio or television set so to disturb or annoy any other occupant of the building. 17. doesnotowna dog and thatthe Tenant(s)shall notkeeporharbor adogwithin the Apartment at any time during theExtensionTerm of thisLease. 18.Apartment floors shall be covered with rugs or carpeting to the extent of at least 80%of thefloor area of eachroom excepting only kitchens,pantries,bathrooms and hallways.The tackingstripforwall-to-wall carpetingwillbe glued,not nailed to the floor. 19.It is agreed between theLandlord and Tenant,that should the Landlord incur any legal fees arising due to a breach of this contract or covenant thereof by the tenant during the Lease term,theLandlord may at its option deduct same from the security deposit. 20.Fire places are not to be used;they are for decorative purposes only. 21.In November 2004,NewYork City'sLocal Law7went into effectrequiring residential and commercial housing owners to install CO alarms in sleeping areas of all apartments and housesthathavefossil-fuel burning equipmentincluding furnaces,boilers,waterheaters and fireplaces.CO alarms have a defined end-of-life in December 2011 allows owners to replace these expired units andbe reimbursed for the cost,up to$25,by the tenant. 22.Tenant shall make all rent and additional rent payments infull.Payment or Lease shall be deemed tobe a partial payment on account.Under no circumstances shall Landlord's acceptance of apartialpayment constituteaccord and satisfaction. Norwill Landlord's acceptance of a partial paymentforfeit Landlordrightto collect any balance due,despite any endorsement,stipulation,or other statement on any check or money order.The Landlord may accept any partial payment check or money order with any conditional endorsement without prejudice to the Landlord's right to recover any remainingbalance due,or topursue any otherremedyavailable under the Lease,at law or otherwise. 23. a.Resident's duties:Resident agrees,at his sole cost and expense,to comply with all state,federal,municipal and local governments,departments,commissions and boards regarding the collection,sorting,separation andrecycling of waste products, garbage, refuse and trash.Resident shall sort and separate such items into categories as provided by law,and in accordance with the rules and regulations adoptedbyOwner for the sorting and separating of such designated recyclable materials. b.Owner's rightsif resident fails to comply:Owner reserves the right,where permitted by law,to refuse to collect or accept from Resident any waste products, garbage,refuse or trash which is not separated and sorted as required by law,and to require Resident to arrange for such collection, at Resident's sole cost and expense, usinga contractor satisfactory toOwner. c.Fines and penalties;indemnification of Owner:Resident shall pay all costs. expenses,fines,penalties or damages imposed on Owner or Resident by reason of Resident's failure to comply with Paragraphs a and b above,and shall indemnify, defend,and hold Owner harmless from and against and actions,claims,and suits arising from such noncompliance,using counsel reasonable satisfactory to Owner,if Owner so elects.Resident's noncompliance with paragraphs a,b or c shall constitute aviolation of substantialobligation of the tenancy andOwner's rulesand regulations. Resident shall be liable to owner for any costs or expenses, including attorneys'fee. 24.TENANTAGREESTHATE-MAILWILLBEDEEMEDSUFFICIENTNOTICEFOR ALLLANDLORDANDTENANTCORRESPONDENCE: ADDRESS:BNEVES242@AOL.COM 25.Term: The term of this lease shall commence on November 1, 2012 and will expire on the earliest of:(i) the date of death of the Tenant;or(i) the date that Tenant vacates the apartment.Tenant acknowledges and agrees that this lease and its terms are solelyforherbenefit.Tenant shall notlicense,assign or subletthe apartment or any interest in the apartment.This lease and the benefits conferred hereunder shall not be binding upon orinure to any of Tenant's heirs,executors, assigns and/or successors in interest.In the event that Tenant licenses,sublets and/or assigns the apartment,Landlord shall serve a five day notice toTenant that she has breached this provision.Upon the expiration of thefive day notice,the rent for the apartment shall increase so as to be thefairmarketrentfor the apartment which shallbe determinedbyLandlordinits sole and reasonablediscretion,effective as of the date of the expiration of the five day notice.
